description: I'm a Software Engineer with 2+ years of experience building scalable, distributed microservices in edtech. My work is driven by a passion for system design, performance optimization, and solving complex architectural challenges.

At Educational Initiatives, I led the migration from fragmented per-product monolithic content systems to a unified cloud-native AWS microservices platform, the Common Authoring Platform (CAP), now serving 4 products and 100K+ content items. I own the Core Content Microservice end-to-end, from design to delivery.
I graduated from Pandit Deendayal Energy University with a CGPA of 9.80. Beyond coding, I've led technical communities and published research in NLP.

publication.title: Drug Review Classification Using Sentiment Analysis of Drug Reviews

highlights.text: Led migration from monolithic, per-product content management to a unified cloud-native AWS microservices platform by architecting the Core Content Microservice using reusable, extensible SOLID-based content containers.
Designed and owned Core Content Microservice: full content lifecycle, container assembly, adaptive learning logic
highlights.impact: CAP serving ASSET, CARES, MindSpark, OpenDoor

highlights.text: Optimized Search API performance via batch processing, parallel hydration, composite indexing, N+1 query elimination, and recursive PostgreSQL CTEs.
Reduced PostgreSQL load using Redis Cluster caching with cache-aside and write-through strategies and configurable TTL, maintaining backward-compatible REST APIs.
highlights.impact: 20-30% lower DB load · zero breaking changes

highlights.text: Designed a bitwise authorization module for CAP, encoding permissions across roles, orgs, and users into a versioned hex bit mask with constant-time access checks while eliminating cross-service auth inconsistencies.
Developed reusable Angular 21 UI components for the internal authoring platform, contributing to a shared component library reused across product teams.

Engineered a configurable, Jira-inspired content review engine with reusable workflow transitions, conditional validations, and automated actions, replacing hardcoded review rules with per-content-type workflows.
Built an LLM-driven planning pipeline integrated with EI-MCP Gateway to transform technical specs into structured implementation plans, grounded in architecture and coding-standard rule files.
Led design & code reviews for 20+ features; mentored team on microservices best practices
Designed a proof-of-concept on India's ABHA Sandbox to digitize hospital workflows across patient registration, records management, and consent verification.
Delivered LIMS modules integrated with the national health ecosystem, enabling digital health records, ABHA card generation, secure medical document storage, and consent-based verification.
highlights.impact: 2 modules · reduced dependency on physical reports

highlights.text: Engineered and tested RESTful APIs for seamless data exchange and interoperability across digital healthcare systems, ensuring compliance with healthcare standards.
